title: Midpoint convexity from bounded tree potentials and path costs
summary: Four real Banach spaces defined by bounded tree potentials satisfy the averaged asymptotic midpoint bound $`\widehat\delta(t)\ge\sqrt{1+t^2/4}-1`$ for $`0\lt t\lt 1`$, while none admits an asymptotically uniformly convex (AUC) renorming. On finite-height trees, the globally constrained norm equals the least additive cost of a Hilbert vector and root paths. The quadratic path and segment-start outer Hilbert sums are reflexive and asymptotically midpoint uniformly convex, and admit no equivalent AUC norm.
family_title: Reflexive midpoint convexity and diamond distortion

review.reason: Studies midpoint convexity bounds and renorming obstructions for Banach spaces built from tree potentials.
